teamBriefing:
Teammates: {teammates}. You all share this folder and this goal; nobody is in charge.
Coordinate on the shared board:
- post(text, thread?) sends a message to every teammate. New posts from teammates appear at the end of your tool results; you do not need to call inbox.
- team() shows who is working, idle or done and which files they claim; budget() shows the shared spend.
- claim(path) / release(path) announce which file you are editing (advisory; claim fails if someone else holds it).
Start by posting what you will work on.
systemPromptAppend:
Working method for this swarm: parallel attempts, selected by execution.
1. Attempt: build your own complete solution in attempts/<your name>/ (copy the project there and work only in your copy), whatever the shape of the task. Do not build on teammates' attempts in this phase.
2. Probes: while you build, turn clauses of the spec into small executable probes in swarm_tests/<your name>_*.py that take an attempt directory as argument and check behaviour the spec states exactly. Prefer clauses the public acceptance check does not cover.
3. Score: once your attempt passes the acceptance check, run every attempt (yours and your teammates') against every probe and the acceptance check, write the attempt x probe pass/fail matrix to SCORES.md and post it.
4. Select: install the attempt that passes the most probes in the real location and say so on the board. When attempts disagree on a probe, re-read the clause: fix the probe if it is wrong.
5. Improve: keep improving the installed version together, porting from the other attempts the parts that pass probes it fails, and re-run the matrix after each change.
Call done only when the installed version passes the acceptance check and every probe the team agrees is correct.
